verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ॥
verses.translit_en: raag malaar baanee bhagat naamadhev jeeau kee||

en.bdb: Raag Malaar, The Word Of The Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:
en.ms: Rag Malar. Hymns of reverend. Saint Nam Dev.

en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
en.ms: There is but One God. By the True Guru's grace, He is obtained.

en.bdb: Serve the King, the Sovereign Lord of the World. He has no ancestry; He is immaculate and pure.
en.ms: Serve thou thy Lord, thy king, who is Unlineal and Immaculate.

pu.ss: ਮੈਂ ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਦਾ ਰੱਖਿਅਕ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਕੋਈ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਕੁਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਅਤੇ (

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: bhagat dhaan dheejai jaacheh sa(n)t jan ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: Please bless me with the gift of devotion, which the humble Saints beg for. ||1||Pause||
en.ms: Bless Thou me with the gift of Thy meditation for which the saintly persons beg Thee, O Lord. Pause.

pu.ss: (ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਦਰ ਤੇ) ਸਾਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਹਨ (ਅਤੇ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ ਕਿ ਹੇ ਦਾਤਾ! ਅਸਾਨੂੰ) ਆਪਣੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ ।੧।ਰਹਾਉ।

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਦਿਗ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਰਾਇਚਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਭਵਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਸਾਲਾ ਸਪਤ ਲੋਕ ਸਾਮਾਨਿ ਪੂਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa(n) chai ghar dhig dhisai saraichaa baiku(n)Th bhavan chitrasaalaa sapat lok saamaan pooreeale ||

en.bdb: His Home is the pavilion seen in all directions; His ornamental heavenly realms fill the seven worlds alike.
en.ms: Such is the Lord in whose home is seen the pavilion made of all the directions, who has ornamental celestial mansion and who is fully filling the seven worlds alike.

pu.ss: ਉਹ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ (ਮਾਨੋ) ਇਕ ਬੜਾ ਵੱਡਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਹੈ (ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਇਤਨਾ ਵੱਡਾ ਸ਼ਾਮੀਆਨਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ) ਇਹ ਚਾਰੇ ਦਿਸ਼ਾਂ (ਉਸ ਸ਼ਾਮੀਆਨੇ ਦੀ ਮਾਨੋ) ਕਨਾਤ ਹੈ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਲਛਿਮੀ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੀਵੜੇ ਕਉਤਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਕੋਟਵਾਲੁ ਸੁ ਕਰਾ ਸਿਰੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa(n) chai ghar lachhimee kuaaree cha(n)dh sooraj dheevaRe kautak kaal bapuRaa koTavaalu su karaa siree ||

en.bdb: In His Home, the virgin Lakshmi dwells. The moon and the sun are His two lamps; the wretched Messenger of Death stages his dramas, and levies taxes on all.
en.ms: In whose home abides the virgin goddess of wealth. The moon and the sun are His two lamps, the poor death, which exhibits wondrous plays and which levies tax on all, is His police-official.

pu.ss: (ਰਾਜਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਰਾਜ-ਮਹਲਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਤਸਵੀਰ-ਘਰ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਇਕ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ) ਸਾਰਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਉਸ ਦਾ (ਮਾਨੋ) ਤਸਵੀਰ-ਘਰ ਹੈ

en.bdb: Such is my Sovereign Lord King, the Supreme Lord of all. ||1||
en.ms: Such is that venerable Man lion Emperor.

pu.ss: (ਰਾਜਿਆਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਰਾਣੀਆਂ ਦਾ ਜੋਬਨ ਤਾਂ ਚਾਰ ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਇਕ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਹੈ)

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੁਲਾਲੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਚਤੁਰ ਮੁਖੁ ਡਾਂਵੜਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਰਾਚੀਲੇ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa(n) chai ghar kulaal brahamaa chatur mukh ddaa(n)vaRaa jin bisavai sa(n)saar raacheele ||

en.bdb: In His House, the four-faced Brahma, the cosmic potter lives. He created the entire universe.
en.ms: In whose mansion is the four-faced Brahma, the fashioning potter, Who has created the whole world.

pu.ss: ਦੇ ਮਹਲ ਵਿਚ ਲੱਛਮੀ ਹੈ, ਜੋ ਸਦਾ ਜੁਆਨ ਰਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ (ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਜੋਬਨ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਨਹੀਂ), ਇਹ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ (ਉਸ ਦੇ ਮਹਲ ਦੇ, ਮਾਨੋ) ਨਿੱਕੇ ਜਿਹੇ ਦੀਵੇ ਹਨ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਾਵਲਾ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰੂ ਤਤ ਸਾਰਖਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਾਖੀਲੇ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa(n) kai ghar ieesar baavalaa jagat guroo tat saarakhaa giaan bhaakheele ||

en.bdb: In His House, the insane Shiva, the Guru of the World, lives; he imparts spiritual wisdom to explain the essence of reality.
en.ms: In whose home is the crazy Shiva, the world-teacher, who utters the true Divine knowledge.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਡਾਂਗੀਆ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲੇਖੀਆ ॥
verses.translit_en: paap pu(n)n jaa(n) chai ddaa(n)geeaa dhuaarai chitr gupat lekheeaa ||

en.bdb: Sin and virtue are the standard-bearers at His Door; Chitr and Gupt are the recording angels of the conscious and subconscious.
en.ms: At whose gate evil and good are mace-bearers and Chitar and Gupat, the scribes.

en.bdb: The Righteous Judge of Dharma, the Lord of Destruction, is the door-man.
en.ms: The Righteous judge, the Lord of deluge, is His door-man.

en.bdb: Such is the Supreme Sovereign Lord of the World. ||2||
en.ms: Such a sovereign is that Reverend cherisher of the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਰਿਖੀ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਢਾਢੀਆ ਗਾਵੰਤ ਆਛੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa(n) chai ghar gan ga(n)dharab rikhee bapuRe ddaaddeeaa gaava(n)t aachhai ||

en.bdb: In His Home are the heavenly heralds, celestial singers, Rishis and poor minstrels, who sing so sweetly.
en.ms: Within whose Home are the heavenly heralds, celestial singers, the sages, and the poor minstrels, who sing sweetly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪੀਆ ਅਨਗਰੂਆ ਆਖਾੜਾ ਮੰਡਲੀਕ ਬੋਲ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਕਾਛੇ ॥
verses.translit_en: sarab saasatr bahu roopeeaa anagarooaa aakhaaRaa ma(n)ddaleek bol boleh kaachhe ||

en.bdb: All the Shaastras take various forms in His theater, singing beautiful songs.
en.ms: All the Shastras are His actors; stupendous is His arena. The sovereigns utter beauteous songs in his praise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਉਰ ਢੂਲ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਹੈ ਪਵਣੁ ॥
verses.translit_en: chaur ddool jaa(n) chai hai pavan ||

en.bdb: The wind waves the fly-brush over Him;
en.ms: Such is the Lord, wind is whose waving fly-brush,

en.bdb: His hand-maiden is Maya, who has conquered the world.
en.ms: whose handmaiden is mammon, who has vanquished the world.

en.bdb: The shell of the earth is His fireplace.
en.ms: (The mortal world) or (half an egg) is whose fire place.

en.bdb: Such is the Sovereign Lord of the three worlds. ||3||
en.ms: Such is that Sovereign the Lord of the three worlds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੂਰਮਾ ਪਾਲੁ ਸਹਸ੍ਰ ਫਨੀ ਬਾਸਕੁ ਸੇਜ ਵਾਲੂਆ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa(n) chai ghar kooramaa paal sahasr fanee baasak sej vaalooaa ||

en.bdb: In His Home, the celestial turtle is the bed-frame, woven with the strings of the thousand-headed snake.
en.ms: In whose home is the bed-stead of the tortoise and the couch-cord of the thousand headed serpent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਠਾਰਹ ਭਾਰ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਮਾਲਣੀ ਛਿਨਵੈ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਮੇਘ ਮਾਲਾ ਪਾਣੀਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit_en: aThaareh bhaar banaasapatee maalanee chhinavai karoRee megh maalaa paaneehaareeaa ||

en.bdb: His flower-girls are the eighteen loads of vegetation; His water-carriers are the nine hundred sixty million clouds.
en.ms: Whose flower-girl is the eighteen loads of vegetation and water-carriers are the ninety-six millions of clouds ranges.

en.bdb: His sweat is the Ganges River.
en.ms: The perspiration of whose nails is the Ganges.

en.bdb: The seven seas are His water-pitchers.
en.ms: The seven ocean are whose pitcher stands.

en.bdb: The creatures of the world are His household utensils.
en.ms: So many creatures are whose vessels.

en.bdb: Such is the Sovereign Lord King of the three worlds. ||4||
en.ms: Such is He, the Monarch, the Master of the Three worlds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਕਟ ਵਰਤੀ ਅਰਜਨੁ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਅੰਬਰੀਕੁ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਨੇਜੈ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਬਾਨਵੈ ਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa(n) chai ghar nikaT varatee arajan dhraoo prahalaadh a(n)bareek naaradh nejai sidh budh gan ga(n)dharab baanavai helaa ||

en.bdb: In His home are Arjuna, Dhroo, Prahlaad, Ambreek, Naarad, Nayjaa, the Siddhas and Buddhas, the ninety-two heavenly heralds and celestial singers in their wondrous play.
en.ms: In whose Home are Arjan, Dhru, Prahlad, Ambrik, Narad, Neja, Adepts, Budhas, Heavenly-heralds and ninety two, celestial singers, as aids-de-camps, who perform wondrous plays.

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਹਹਿ ਘਰੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: ete jeea jaa(n) chai heh gharee ||

en.bdb: All the creatures of the world are in His House.
en.ms: In whose mansion, there are creatures of so many kinds.

en.bdb: The Lord is diffused in the inner beings of all.
en.ms: Within all the beings is diffused my Lord.

en.bdb: Prays Naam Dayv, seek His Protection.
en.ms: Supplicates Namdev, seek thou, O man,

en.bdb: All the devotees are His banner and insignia. ||5||1||
en.ms: the protection of Him, whose manifestation are all his saints.
